messages:
Jordan: Hey all — first-week quick one: where should I stash my ramp notes in Notion and how do I get edit access to the team templates? I only have view rights atm.
Alex: Welcome! Templates live under: Docs Home > Team Spaces > Devex > Templates (https://redwood.notion.so/...). You can duplicate any template into your Private workspace.
Maria: Tip: keep personal ramp notes in a private page called `Jordan — Ramp` under Workspace > Private > Onboarding. Tag with #ramp so others can find relevant examples.
devex-bot: How-to: Request edit perms by opening the page -> Share -> Invite people/groups -> add `doc-editors@redwood.com`. Alternatively run the help-docs slash command or email docs-admin@redwood.com.
Alex: If the group invite errors, ask for the `docs-editor` role from People Ops or ping me. To copy a template: click the ••• menu (top-right) -> Duplicate -> pick "Private" or "Team" workspace.
Sam: Small governance note: for team-runbooks use the locked "Team Runbook" template. If you need write access there, request an unlock via #devex-docs with a short justification.
Jordan: I tried the share flow but got a permissions error when adding the group. Can someone manually add me?
Alex: On it — adding Jordan as docs-editor now. You should see edit rights in a couple minutes; if not, try logging out & back in or clearing cache.
Jordan: Confirmed — I can now duplicate and edit templates. Thanks Alex!! :tada:
Maria: PS — when you update any team templates please post a 1-line changelog in #devex-docs (what changed + why) so we keep history.
Sam: Also add yourself as Page Owner at the top of any page you create (small heading: Owner: Jordan). That helps audit and handoffs later.
Jordan: Will do. Appreciate the fast help folks 🙂
